annotations.title: Send or schedule a Klaviyo campaign

description: SEND or SCHEDULE a Klaviyo campaign draft. An email cannot be unsent, so this is gated on how many people it reaches: without confirm:true nothing is sent and you get Klaviyo's own count of recipients with the subject, sender, lists and timing. Show the user that number; only after they say yes call again with confirm:true AND confirmRecipients set to that count (a mismatch, a zero, or a count Klaviyo cannot produce is refused). sendTime (ISO, in the future) schedules instead of sending now; strategy 'local_timezone' sends at that time in each recipient's own timezone. Free. Needs Klaviyo connected (Settings > Connectors > Klaviyo, or connect_connector with a private API key).

confirm.description: true only after the user approved this exact send

confirmRecipients.description: the recipient count the dry run showed the user

sendTime.description: ISO date-time in the future; omit to send now
